items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I had Carl White... Yes, there was Carl White -- he played the banjo and he sang. Leroy Tibbs played the tenor saxophone. Clarence Cummings, he played the violin, and Willie Lynch, he played drums.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, you mentioned her name.
She run the place. It's one of the best spots on the north shore for entertainment, see, they had all colored entertainment there, the best. I had Carl White.
